label: For "Medical Image De-Identification (DICOM)": Remove PHI from DICOM headers and burned-in pixel text (and facial features in head scans) at scale for research sharing. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Testing on common modalities only.
